tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi lam 'bras bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang 'bri tho bzhugs so// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang 'bri tshul ni sku thang ras gzhi'i 'og g.yas zur du/ 'grig mtshams mgron lha g.yu thog gi lung pa mtshon byed ri rtse shing nags tshal khang pa dkar po phran bu bcas pa'i khrod yangs par ri gdong lta bur 'bol lding ba dmar po'i steng du rje nyid rab byung sku mdog dkar po zhal gdong dkyus ring dbu mtshams g.yas g.yon mtho zhing mdun dma' ba sku rgyab la nye ba'i cha spyi ther phran bu sku chos sku sham sogs dkyus 'gre/ zhabs rjen rdor skyil sku drang por bsrangs ba'i phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gsung ngag glegs bam/ spyan gnyis bar snang du gzigs pa'i nam mkha' bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog can la 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od dkar po legs zlum skor rgya che ba'i nang du/ dbus su pad zla la bla ma sa chen/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs kar pad yu 'dzin pa'i snyan thad du me tog kha phye ba na bza' dang sku'i rnam 'gyur gdung rabs bzhin/ de'i g.yas pad zla la slob dpon rin po che/ sku'i rnam 'gyur na bza' gdung rabs bzhin las phyag chos 'chad/ g.yon du pad zla la rje btsun rin po che sku'i rnam 'gyur na bza' gdung rabs bzhin las/ g.yas thugs kar rdo rje g.yon dril bu dkur brten/ slob dpon rin po che'i 'og tu pad zla la chos rje sa paṇa sku'i rnam 'gyur na bza' dbu zhwa gdung rabs bzhin las phyag chos 'chad/ rje btsun gyi 'og tu pad zla la 'phags pa rin po che sku'i rnam 'gyur na bza' gdung rabs bzhin las phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gong ma lnga'i g.yas steng du pad nyi bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ kyai rdo rje dkyus bzhin steng pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la/

bde mchog nag po dkyus bzhin/ sa chen gyi sku dpung g.yas g.yon/ zhabs pus g.yas g.yon/ dbu steng gi cha rnams su pad zla'i gdan la 'khor lo rdo rje nor bu pad+ma ral gri rnams/ gong ma lnga'i phyi'i 'ja' 'od kyi nang g.yas steng / rnam rgyal mchod rten/ de 'og byang chen mchod rten/ gong ma lnga'i phyi 'ja' 'od kyi nang g.yon steng byang chub mchod rten che ba/ de'i g.yon du byang chub mchod rten chung ba/ 'od kor gyi phyi na/ de nang na phyed/ 'od kor gyi nang g.yas phyogs 'og thad du/ mgon po lcam dral dkyus bzhin rje btsun rin po che'i phyag g.yas nas 'ja' dkar po thon pa 'od kor gyi phyi brdal nas sngon po dang gnyis su gyur pa'i rtse mo nas 'ja' tshon sna lnga dar thag gi tshul du ngor chen gyi phyag gi glegs bam la zug pa rnams 'bri rgyu yin/ ces pa'ang kun blos rang 'dod bzhin bris pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi lam 'bras bka' rgya thim pa'i gzigs snang 'bri tho/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
